# Refactoring.Guru for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/refactoring-guru/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/refactoring-guru
```

Gemini asks you to confirm before it installs (trust and consent prompts).

- 20 rule skills the model activates on its own (`refactoring-guru-<name>`).
- 10 workflows and 6 modes as slash commands: `/refactoring-guru:review src/`, `/refactoring-guru:mode-mentor`. They are commands, not skills, so they add nothing to every request.
- 22 subagents, started with `@refactoring-guru-<name> <task>`. The read-only ones are constrained by `policies/read-only-roles.toml` (deny rules on the text of a shell command: a guard rail, not a sandbox).

Gemini loads extension commands only in a trusted folder; if `/refactoring-guru:review` is missing and the footer says `untrusted`, run `/permissions trust`. Answering a shell prompt with "Allow for this session" creates an allow rule that outranks the policy's deny rules for that command word; see docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md.
